nodes.summary: The rate `κ = √(r / (6 D))` of the Ablowitz–Zeppetella wave.
nodes.title: Rate of the Ablowitz–Zeppetella wave

nodes.summary: The Ablowitz–Zeppetella speed `c = 5 √(r D / 6)` (`5 / √6` when `D = r = 1`).
nodes.title: Speed of the Ablowitz–Zeppetella wave

nodes.summary: The derivative of the Ablowitz–Zeppetella profile, `-2 κ C e^{κ z} (1 + C e^{κ z})⁻³`.
nodes.title: Derivative of the Ablowitz–Zeppetella profile

nodes.summary: The Ablowitz–Zeppetella profile `U(z) = (1 + C exp (κ z))⁻²`.
nodes.title: Ablowitz–Zeppetella wave profile

nodes.summary: Kolmogorov–Petrovsky–Piskunov: fronts exist at every speed `c ≥ 2 √(r D)`, and they are strictly decreasing.
nodes.title: Kolmogorov–Petrovsky–Piskunov: fronts exist at every speed `c ≥ 2 √(r D)`

nodes.summary: Time derivative of the wave `u(x, t) = U(x - c t)`: `∂u/∂t = -c U'(x - c t)`.
nodes.title: Time derivative of a traveling wave

nodes.summary: Space derivative of the wave: `∂u/∂x = U'(x - c t)`.
nodes.title: Space derivative of a traveling wave

nodes.summary: Second space derivative of the wave; with `hD : D ≠ 0` it gives the PDE `-c U' = D U'' + r U (1 - U)`, i.e. `∂u/∂t = D ∂²u/∂x² + r u (1 - u)`.
nodes.title: Traveling wave solves the Fisher–KPP equation

nodes.summary: For `D, r, C > 0`, `(1 + C exp (z √(r / (6 D))))⁻²` is a front of speed `5 √(r D / 6)`.
nodes.title: The Ablowitz–Zeppetella front

nodes.summary: A traveling front of speed `c`: a wave profile with `0 < U < 1`, `U → 1` at `-∞` and `U → 0` at `+∞`.
nodes.title: Traveling front of the Fisher–KPP equation

nodes.summary: `U` is a traveling-wave profile of speed `c` for `∂u/∂t = D ∂²u/∂x² + r u (1 - u)`: it is twice differentiable with first derivative `U'` and `U'' = -(c U' + r U (1 - U)) / D`, which for `D ≠ 0` is the profile equation `D U'' + c U' + r U (1 - U) = 0`.
nodes.title: Traveling-wave profile of the Fisher–KPP equation

nodes.summary: If `D, r > 0` and `c² < 4 r D`, a wave profile tending to `0` at `+∞` is not eventually positive. (This excludes `|c| < 2 √(r D)`, not `c < 2 √(r D)` for negative `c`.)
nodes.title: No traveling wave with `c² < 4 r D`

nodes.summary: A front of speed `c` needs `c² ≥ 4 r D`; for `c ≥ 0` this is `c ≥ 2 √(r D)`.
nodes.title: Minimal speed of Fisher–KPP traveling fronts

nodes.summary: The Ablowitz–Zeppetella speed exceeds the minimal speed: `2 √(r D) < 5 √(r D / 6)`.
nodes.title: Ablowitz–Zeppetella speed exceeds the minimal front speed

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
